policy: Discover and retain all artifacts. Unknown or incompatible data remains a visible backlog; never infer approval from age, filename, or existence. Exclusion requires a recorded reason. All selected data still passes final split, native, token and dedup audits.
trajectory_identity_policy: Latest eligible completed artifact per trajectory ID enters the default snapshot; all older copies/revisions remain on disk and in the ledger with their hash and replacement link. Different IDs are not discarded for similar content; final rendered-pair audit handles that.
